entries.notes: R44 audit: er- is correctly treated as inseparable; Partizip II without ge- and the examples/Spanish explanations are consistent. No blocking correction.
R44 audit: miss- is correctly treated as inseparable in the covered verbs; missverstanden/misslungen and no-ge behavior are consistent. No blocking correction.
R44 audit: nach- is correctly presented as separable; V2 separation and ge insertion in nachgefragt/nachgedacht are correct. Spanish rendering is understandable; no blocking correction.

R44 audit: un- is correctly described as a derivational negating/contrastive prefix used especially with adjectives and nouns; examples and distinction from nicht are coherent. No blocking correction.

R44 audit: unter- is correctly described as allowing separable and inseparable verbs depending on lexical meaning/stress; untergehen/untergegangen and untersuchen/untersucht are consistent. No blocking correction.
